issue_title: [Enhancement] Add __eq__ and __hash__ methods for proper equality comparison
summary: Added custom __eq__ and __hash__ methods to the Todo dataclass to enable proper equality comparison and set/dict usage. Equality is based on id only for hash consistency.

implementation_details.approach: Modified @dataclass decorator with eq=False and added custom __eq__ and __hash__ methods
implementation_details.equality_logic: Compares Todo instances by id only
implementation_details.hash_logic: Hashes based on id for set/dict usage

acceptance_criteria_met: Todo(id=1, text='a') == Todo(id=1, text='a') returns True
Todo instances with same id can be used in sets
risks: None - minimal change with clear semantics
